One-time setup: a free Census key

The Census Bureau requires a key on every request. It's free, takes two minutes, and never expires.

  1. Request a key at api.census.gov/data/key_signup.html (any organisation name, your email).
  2. Open index.html, find CENSUS_KEY near the top of the script, paste the key between the quotes, redeploy.
  3. Or, to try it right now on this phone only, paste it here:

Count backward from opening night.

A master plan begins at the first night of the meetings and works back twelve to eighteen months. Give Terrain five numbers and a date; it lays the phases on the calendar and sets a starting benchmark for each one.

Find your conference

Tap your state on the map, or search the list. Then register with your name, email and church.
